314	/// Color the leading status token of `value` (e.g. `PASSED` in `PASSED 1/1`,
315	/// `completed` in `completed -> done`) by its status tone, leaving the rest
316	/// plain. A value whose leading token is not a recognized status is returned
317	/// unchanged. Safe for an unpadded (last-column / kv) value.
318	#[allow(dead_code)]
319	pub(crate) fn color_status_word(value: &str) -> String {
320	    let mut parts = value.splitn(2, ' ');
321	    let Some(first) = parts.next() else {
322	        return value.to_string();
323	    };
324	    let tone = status_tone(first);
325	    if tone == Tone::Plain {
326	        return value.to_string();
327	    }
328	    match parts.next() {
329	        Some(rest) => format!("{} {}", render(Stream::Stdout, tone, first), rest),
330	        None => render(Stream::Stdout, tone, first),
331	    }
332	}

409	pub(crate) fn replace_current_line(stream: Stream, text: impl AsRef<str>) -> io::Result<()> {
410	    if !stream_is_terminal(stream) {
411	        return Ok(());
412	    }
413	    let text = replacement_line_text(text.as_ref(), current_terminal_width());
414	    match stream {
415	        Stream::Stdout => {
416	            print!("\r{text}\x1b[K");
417	            io::stdout().flush()
418	        }

421	            io::stderr().flush()

426	fn stream_is_terminal(stream: Stream) -> bool {
427	    match stream {
428	        Stream::Stdout => io::stdout().is_terminal(),
429	        Stream::Stderr => io::stderr().is_terminal(),
430	    }
431	}
432	
433	fn current_terminal_width() -> usize {
434	    crossterm::terminal::size()
435	        .ok()
436	        .map(|(columns, _)| usize::from(columns))
437	        .or_else(|| {
438	            std::env::var("COLUMNS")
439	                .ok()
440	                .and_then(|columns| columns.parse::<usize>().ok())
441	        })
442	        .filter(|columns| *columns > 0)
443	        .unwrap_or(120)
444	}
445	
446	fn replacement_line_text(text: &str, terminal_width: usize) -> String {
447	    let visible_limit = terminal_width.saturating_sub(1);
448	    truncate_visible_single_line(text, visible_limit)
449	}
450	
451	fn truncate_visible_single_line(text: &str, max_visible: usize) -> String {
452	    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthChar;
453	    if max_visible == 0 {
454	        return String::new();
455	    }
456	    let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len().min(max_visible));
457	    let mut chars = text.chars().peekable();
458	    let mut visible = 0usize;
459	    let mut style_active = false;
460	    while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
461	        if let Some((sequence, active)) = read_ansi_sequence(ch, &mut chars) {
462	            style_active = active;
463	            out.push_str(&sequence);
464	            continue;
465	        }
466	        let glyph = match ch {
467	            '\n' | '\r' => ' ',
468	            _ => ch,
469	        };
470	        let glyph_width = UnicodeWidthChar::width(glyph).unwrap_or(0);
471	        if visible + glyph_width > max_visible {
472	            break;
473	        }
474	        out.push(glyph);
475	        visible += glyph_width;
476	    }
477	    if style_active {
478	        out.push_str(ANSI_RESET);
479	    }
480	    out
481	}

1	import type { RuntimeEnv } from "../runtime.js";
2	import type { OnboardOptions } from "./onboard-types.js";
3	import { formatCliCommand } from "../cli/command-format.js";
4	import { readConfigFileSnapshot } from "../config/config.js";
5	import { assertSupportedRuntime } from "../infra/runtime-guard.js";
6	import { defaultRuntime } from "../runtime.js";
7	import { resolveUserPath } from "../utils.js";
8	import { isDeprecatedAuthChoice, normalizeLegacyOnboardAuthChoice } from "./auth-choice-legacy.js";
9	import { DEFAULT_WORKSPACE, handleReset } from "./onboard-helpers.js";
10	import { runInteractiveOnboarding } from "./onboard-interactive.js";
11	import { runNonInteractiveOnboarding } from "./onboard-non-interactive.js";
12	
13	export async function onboardCommand(opts: OnboardOptions, runtime: RuntimeEnv = defaultRuntime) {
14	  assertSupportedRuntime(runtime);
15	  const originalAuthChoice = opts.authChoice;
16	  const normalizedAuthChoice = normalizeLegacyOnboardAuthChoice(originalAuthChoice);
17	  if (opts.nonInteractive && isDeprecatedAuthChoice(originalAuthChoice)) {
18	    runtime.error(
19	      [
20	        `Auth choice "${String(originalAuthChoice)}" is deprecated.`,
21	        'Use "--auth-choice token" (Anthropic setup-token) or "--auth-choice openai-codex".',
22	      ].join("\n"),
23	    );
24	    runtime.exit(1);
25	    return;
26	  }
27	  if (originalAuthChoice === "claude-cli") {
28	    runtime.log('Auth choice "claude-cli" is deprecated; using setup-token flow instead.');
29	  }
30	  if (originalAuthChoice === "codex-cli") {
31	    runtime.log('Auth choice "codex-cli" is deprecated; using OpenAI Codex OAuth instead.');
32	  }
33	  const flow = opts.flow === "manual" ? ("advanced" as const) : opts.flow;
34	  const normalizedOpts =
35	    normalizedAuthChoice === opts.authChoice && flow === opts.flow
36	      ? opts
37	      : { ...opts, authChoice: normalizedAuthChoice, flow };
38	
39	  if (normalizedOpts.nonInteractive && normalizedOpts.acceptRisk !== true) {
40	    runtime.error(
41	      [
42	        "Non-interactive onboarding requires explicit risk acknowledgement.",
43	        "Read: https://docs.openclaw.ai/security",
44	        `Re-run with: ${formatCliCommand("openclaw onboard --non-interactive --accept-risk ...")}`,
45	      ].join("\n"),
46	    );
47	    runtime.exit(1);
48	    return;
49	  }
50	
51	  if (normalizedOpts.reset) {
52	    const snapshot = await readConfigFileSnapshot();
53	    const baseConfig = snapshot.valid ? snapshot.config : {};
54	    const workspaceDefault =
55	      normalizedOpts.workspace ?? baseConfig.agents?.defaults?.workspace ?? DEFAULT_WORKSPACE;
56	    await handleReset("full", resolveUserPath(workspaceDefault), runtime);
57	  }
58	
59	  if (process.platform === "win32") {
60	    runtime.log(
61	      [
62	        "Windows detected — OpenClaw runs great on WSL2!",
63	        "Native Windows might be trickier.",
64	        "Quick setup: wsl --install (one command, one reboot)",
65	        "Guide: https://docs.openclaw.ai/windows",
66	      ].join("\n"),
67	    );
68	  }
69	
70	  if (normalizedOpts.nonInteractive) {
71	    await runNonInteractiveOnboarding(normalizedOpts, runtime);
72	    return;
73	  }
74	
75	  await runInteractiveOnboarding(normalizedOpts, runtime);
76	}
77	
78	export type { OnboardOptions } from "./onboard-types.js";
79

19	
20	function guardCancel<T>(value: T | symbol): T {
21	  if (isCancel(value)) {
22	    cancel(stylePromptTitle("Setup cancelled.") ?? "Setup cancelled.");
23	    throw new WizardCancelledError();
24	  }
25	  return value;
26	}
27	
28	export function createClackPrompter(): WizardPrompter {
29	  return {
30	    intro: async (title) => {
31	      intro(stylePromptTitle(title) ?? title);
32	    },
33	    outro: async (message) => {
34	      outro(stylePromptTitle(message) ?? message);
35	    },
36	    note: async (message, title) => {
37	      emitNote(message, title);
38	    },
39	    select: async (params) =>
40	      guardCancel(
41	        await select({
42	          message: stylePromptMessage(params.message),
43	          options: params.options.map((opt) => {
44	            const base = { value: opt.value, label: opt.label };
45	            return opt.hint === undefined ? base : { ...base, hint: stylePromptHint(opt.hint) };
46	          }) as Option<(typeof params.options)[number]["value"]>[],
47	          initialValue: params.initialValue,
48	        }),
49	      ),
50	    multiselect: async (params) =>
51	      guardCancel(
52	        await multiselect({
53	          message: stylePromptMessage(params.message),
54	          options: params.options.map((opt) => {
55	            const base = { value: opt.value, label: opt.label };
56	            return opt.hint === undefined ? base : { ...base, hint: stylePromptHint(opt.hint) };
57	          }) as Option<(typeof params.options)[number]["value"]>[],
58	          initialValues: params.initialValues,
59	        }),
60	      ),
61	    text: async (params) => {
62	      const validate = params.validate;
63	      return guardCancel(
64	        await text({
65	          message: stylePromptMessage(params.message),
66	          initialValue: params.initialValue,
67	          placeholder: params.placeholder,
68	          validate: validate ? (value) => validate(value ?? "") : undefined,
69	        }),
70	      );
71	    },
72	    confirm: async (params) =>
73	      guardCancel(
74	        await confirm({
75	          message: stylePromptMessage(params.message),
76	          initialValue: params.initialValue,
77	        }),
78	      ),
79	    progress: (label: string): WizardProgress => {
80	      const spin = spinner();
81	      spin.start(theme.accent(label));
82	      const osc = createCliProgress({
83	        label,
84	        indeterminate: true,
85	        enabled: true,
86	        fallback: "none",
87	      });
88	      return {
89	        update: (message) => {
90	          spin.message(theme.accent(message));
91	          osc.setLabel(message);
92	        },
93	        stop: (message) => {
94	          osc.done();
95	          spin.stop(message);
96	        },
97	      };
98	    },
99	  };
100	}

#!/usr/bin/env node

import module from "node:module";

// https://nodejs.org/api/module.html#module-compile-cache
if (module.enableCompileCache && !process.env.NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE) {
  try {
    module.enableCompileCache();
  } catch {
    // Ignore errors
  }
}

const isModuleNotFoundError = (err) =>
  err && typeof err === "object" && "code" in err && err.code === "ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND";

const installProcessWarningFilter = async () => {
  // Keep bootstrap warnings consistent with the TypeScript runtime.
  for (const specifier of ["./dist/warning-filter.js", "./dist/warning-filter.mjs"]) {
    try {
      const mod = await import(specifier);
      if (typeof mod.installProcessWarningFilter === "function") {
        mod.installProcessWarningFilter();
        return;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (isModuleNotFoundError(err)) {
        continue;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
};

await installProcessWarningFilter();

const tryImport = async (specifier) => {
  try {
    await import(specifier);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    // Only swallow missing-module errors; rethrow real runtime errors.
    if (isModuleNotFoundError(err)) {
      return false;
    }
    throw err;
  }
};

if (await tryImport("./dist/entry.js")) {
  // OK
} else if (await tryImport("./dist/entry.mjs")) {
  // OK
} else {
  throw new Error("openclaw: missing dist/entry.(m)js (build output).");
}

12	// CheckForUpdates checks for newer versions of the CLI and displays a notification if available
13	func CheckForUpdates(currentVersion string, noVersionCheck bool, silent bool) {
14		if noVersionCheck || currentVersion == "dev" {
15			return
16		}
17		defer func() {
18			if r := recover(); r != nil {
19				// Silently recover from any panic during version check
20				slog.Error("Version check panicked", "error", r)
21			}
22		}()
23	
24		// Create HTTP client with timeout to avoid delays
25		client := &http.Client{
26			Timeout: 2500 * time.Millisecond,
27			CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
28				// Don't follow redirects - we want to capture the redirect URL
29				return http.ErrUseLastResponse
30			},
31		}
32	
33		// Make HEAD request to get redirect URL
34		resp, err := client.Head("https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/releases/latest")
35		if err != nil {
36			slog.Error("Version check failed", "error", err)
37			return
38		}
39		defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }() // HEAD request has minimal body; safe to ignore close error
40	
41		// Get redirect location
42		location := resp.Header.Get("Location")
43		if location == "" {
44			slog.Error("Version check: no redirect location found")
45			return
46		}
47	
48		// Parse version from URL
49		parsedURL, err := url.Parse(location)
50		if err != nil {
51			slog.Error("Version check: failed to parse redirect URL", "error", err)
52			return
53		}
54	
55		// Extract version from path like /releases/tag/v1.2.3
56		versionRegex := regexp.MustCompile(`/releases/tag/v?(.+)$`)
57		matches := versionRegex.FindStringSubmatch(parsedURL.Path)
58		if len(matches) < 2 {
59			slog.Error("Version check: could not extract version from path", "path", parsedURL.Path)
60			return
61		}
62	
63		latestVersion := matches[1]
64	
65		// Simple version comparison - if versions are different, assume newer
66		// This is a simple check; for more complex versioning, we'd need semantic version parsing
67		if latestVersion != currentVersion {
68			if !silent {
69				fmt.Println()
70				fmt.Println("╭─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮")
71				// Check if current version contains "beta"
72				if regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)beta`).MatchString(currentVersion) {
73					fmt.Println("│                  Beta Version in use! 🚀                    │")
74				} else {
75					fmt.Println("│                   Update Available! 🚀                      │")
76				}
77				fmt.Println("├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤")
78				fmt.Printf("│ Current version: %-42s │\n", currentVersion)
79				fmt.Printf("│ Latest version:  %-42s │\n", latestVersion)
80				fmt.Println("├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤")
81				fmt.Println("│ Visit https://docs.specstory.com/quickstart for updates     │")
82				fmt.Println("╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯")
83				fmt.Println()
84			}
85		}
86	}
87

Lifecycle:
  deadreckon completion install
  deadreckon completion install --shell zsh
  deadreckon completion zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_deadreckon
  deadreckon completion bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/deadreckon
  deadreckon completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/deadreckon.fish

The generated script comes from the real clap command tree, so subcommands,
aliases, flags, and shell values stay in sync with `deadreckon --help`.

`install` detects your shell, writes the completion file, and for zsh adds a
managed `.zshrc` block when needed.

Supported shells: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh.";

const INIT_HELP: &str = "\
Lifecycle:
  deadreckon init
  deadreckon doctor
  deadreckon start \"build the thing\"

Use `deadreckon config provider` and `deadreckon config model` later to see or change defaults.";

  deadreckon config remove-provider

Power-user one-run launcher. Most users can begin with `deadreckon start \"goal\"`.

Lifecycle:
  deadreckon run \"build the thing\"
  deadreckon run --goal-file docs/goal.md
  deadreckon run @docs/goal.md
  deadreckon attach latest
  deadreckon status latest
  deadreckon finish latest

Common provider/model changes:
  deadreckon run \"goal\" --provider cli:codex
  deadreckon run \"goal\" --provider cli:codex --model gpt-5.1-codex
  deadreckon run \"goal\" --doc-provider cli:codex
  deadreckon config provider cli:codex
  deadreckon config model gpt-5.1-codex --provider cli:codex

Headless:
  deadreckon run \"goal\" --plain --quiet --sandbox none

Done criteria:
  deadreckon def-done \"build, test, and open in a browser\"
  deadreckon def-done add \"users can save drawings\"
  deadreckon def-done check
  deadreckon def-done show

Modes:
  In a git repo, the default is an isolated worktree.
  Use `--fresh`, `--from <dir>`, `--worktree`, or `--in-place --i-know-its-a-lot` to force a mode.";

32	  primary: string | null;

34	}): boolean {
35	  if (params.hasBuiltinPrimary) {
36	    return true;

38	  if (!params.primary) {

40	  }
41	  return false;

46	    return false;

48	  const [primary, secondary] = getCommandPath(argv, 2);
49	  if (!primary) {
50	    return true;
51	  }
52	  if (primary === "status" || primary === "health" || primary === "sessions") {
53	    return false;
54	  }
55	  if (primary === "config" && (secondary === "get" || secondary === "unset")) {
56	    return false;
57	  }
58	  if (primary === "models" && (secondary === "list" || secondary === "status")) {
59	    return false;
60	  }
61	  return true;

65	  const normalizedArgv = normalizeWindowsArgv(argv);
66	  loadDotEnv({ quiet: true });
67	  normalizeEnv();
68	  if (shouldEnsureCliPath(normalizedArgv)) {
69	    ensureOpenClawCliOnPath();
70	  }
71	
72	  // Enforce the minimum supported runtime before doing any work.
73	  assertSupportedRuntime();
74	
75	  if (await tryRouteCli(normalizedArgv)) {
76	    return;
77	  }
78	
79	  // Capture all console output into structured logs while keeping stdout/stderr behavior.
80	  enableConsoleCapture();
81	
82	  const { buildProgram } = await import("./program.js");
83	  const program = buildProgram();

86	  // These log the error and exit gracefully instead of crashing without trace.
87	  installUnhandledRejectionHandler();

91	    process.exit(1);

152	func writeLongShort(w *colorprofile.Writer, styles Styles, longShort string) {
153		if longShort == "" {
154			return
155		}
156		_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w)
157		_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w, styles.Text.Width(width()).PaddingLeft(shortPad).Render(longShort))
158	}
159	
160	var otherArgsRe = regexp.MustCompile(`(\[.*\])`)
161	
162	// styleUsage stylized styleUsage line for a given command.
163	func styleUsage(c *cobra.Command, styles Program, complete bool) string {
164		u := c.Use
165		if complete {
166			u = c.UseLine()
167		}
168		hasArgs := strings.Contains(u, "[args]")
169		hasFlags := strings.Contains(u, "[flags]") || strings.Contains(u, "[--flags]") || c.HasFlags() || c.HasPersistentFlags() || c.HasAvailableFlags()
170		hasCommands := strings.Contains(u, "[command]") || c.HasAvailableSubCommands()
171		for _, k := range []string{
172			"[args]",
173			"[flags]", "[--flags]",
174			"[command]",
175		} {
176			u = strings.ReplaceAll(u, k, "")
177		}
178	
179		var otherArgs []string //nolint:prealloc
180		for _, arg := range otherArgsRe.FindAllString(u, -1) {
181			u = strings.ReplaceAll(u, arg, "")
182			otherArgs = append(otherArgs, arg)
183		}
184	
185		u = strings.TrimSpace(u)
186	
187		useLine := []string{}
188		if complete {
189			parts := strings.Fields(u)
190			useLine = append(useLine, styles.Name.Render(parts[0]))
191			if len(parts) > 1 {
192				useLine = append(useLine, styles.Command.Render(" "+strings.Join(parts[1:], " ")))
193			}
194		} else {
195			useLine = append(useLine, styles.Command.Render(u))
196		}
197		if hasCommands {
198			useLine = append(
199				useLine,
200				styles.DimmedArgument.Render(" [command]"),
201			)
202		}
203		if hasArgs {
204			useLine = append(
205				useLine,
206				styles.DimmedArgument.Render(" [args]"),
207			)
208		}
209		for _, arg := range otherArgs {
210			useLine = append(
211				useLine,
212				styles.DimmedArgument.Render(" "+arg),
213			)
214		}
215		if hasFlags {
216			useLine = append(
217				useLine,
218				styles.DimmedArgument.Render(" [--flags]"),
219			)
220		}
221		return lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Left, useLine...)
222	}
223	
224	// styleExamples for a given command.
225	// will print both the cmd.Use and cmd.Example bits.
226	func styleExamples(c *cobra.Command, styles Styles) []string {
227		if c.Example == "" {
228			return nil
229		}
230		usage := []string{}
231		examples := strings.Split(c.Example, "\n")
232		var indent bool
233		for i, line := range examples {
234			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
235			if (i == 0 || i == len(examples)-1) && line == "" {
236				continue
237			}
238			s := styleExample(c, line, indent, styles.Codeblock)
239			usage = append(usage, s)
240			indent = len(line) > 1 && (line[len(line)-1] == '\\' || line[len(line)-1] == '|')
241		}
242	
243		return usage
244	}
245	
246	func styleExample(c *cobra.Command, line string, indent bool, styles Codeblock) string {
247		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "# ") {
248			return lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(
249				lipgloss.Left,
250				styles.Comment.Render(line),
251			)
252		}
253	
254		var isQuotedString bool
255		var foundProgramName bool
256		var isRedirecting bool
257		programName := c.Root().Name()
258		args := strings.Fields(line)
259		var cleanArgs []string
260		for i, arg := range args {
261			isQuoteStart := arg[0] == '"' || arg[0] == '\''
262			isQuoteEnd := arg[len(arg)-1] == '"' || arg[len(arg)-1] == '\''
263			isFlag := arg[0] == '-'
264	
265			switch i {
266			case 0:
267				args[i] = ""
268				if indent {
269					args[i] = styles.Program.DimmedArgument.Render("  ")
270					indent = false
271				}
272			default:
273				args[i] = styles.Program.DimmedArgument.Render(" ")
274			}
275	
276			if isRedirecting {
277				args[i] += styles.Program.DimmedArgument.Render(arg)
278				isRedirecting = false
279				continue
280			}
281	
282			switch arg {
283			case "\\":
284				if i == len(args)-1 {
285					args[i] += styles.Program.DimmedArgument.Render(arg)
286					continue
287				}
288			case "|", "||", "-", "&", "&&":
289				args[i] += styles.Program.DimmedArgument.Render(arg)
290				continue
291			}
292	
293			if isRedirect(arg) {
294				args[i] += styles.Program.DimmedArgument.Render(arg)
295				isRedirecting = true
296				continue
297			}
298	
299			if !foundProgramName { //nolint:nestif
300				if isQuotedString {
301					args[i] += styles.Program.QuotedString.Render(arg)
302					isQuotedString = !isQuoteEnd
303					continue
304				}
305				if left, right, ok := strings.Cut(arg, "="); ok {
306					args[i] += styles.Program.Flag.Render(left + "=")
307					if right[0] == '"' {
308						isQuotedString = true
309						args[i] += styles.Program.QuotedString.Render(right)
310						continue
311					}
312					args[i] += styles.Program.Argument.Render(right)
313					continue
314				}
315	
316				if arg == programName || slices.Contains(c.Root().Aliases, arg) {
317					args[i] += styles.Program.Name.Render(arg)
318					foundProgramName = true
319					continue
320				}
321			}
322	
323			if !isQuoteStart && !isQuotedString && !isFlag {
324				cleanArgs = append(cleanArgs, arg)
325			}
326	
327			if !isQuoteStart && !isFlag && isSubCommand(c, cleanArgs, arg) {
328				args[i] += styles.Program.Command.Render(arg)
329				continue
330			}
331			isQuotedString = isQuotedString || isQuoteStart
332			if isQuotedString {
333				args[i] += styles.Program.QuotedString.Render(arg)
334				isQuotedString = !isQuoteEnd
335				continue
336			}
337			// handle a flag
338			if isFlag {
339				name, value, ok := strings.Cut(arg, "=")
340				// it is --flag=value
341				if ok {
342					args[i] += lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(
343						lipgloss.Left,
344						styles.Program.Flag.Render(name+"="),
345						styles.Program.Argument.Render(value),
346					)
347					continue
348				}
349				// it is either --bool-flag or --flag value
350				args[i] += lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(
351					lipgloss.Left,
352					styles.Program.Flag.Render(name),
353				)
354				continue
355			}
356	
357			args[i] += styles.Program.Argument.Render(arg)
358		}
359	
360		return lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(
361			lipgloss.Left,
362			args...,
363		)
364	}
365	
366	func evalFlags(c *cobra.Command, styles Styles) (map[string]string, []string) {
367		flags := map[string]string{}
368		keys := []string{}
369		c.Flags().VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
370			if f.Hidden {
371				return
372			}
373			var parts []string
374			if f.Shorthand == "" {
375				parts = append(
376					parts,
377					styles.Program.Flag.Render("--"+f.Name),
378				)
379			} else {
380				parts = append(
381					parts,
382					styles.Program.Flag.Render("-"+f.Shorthand+" --"+f.Name),
383				)
384			}
385			key := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Left, parts...)
386	
387			// Handle multiline flag descriptions by processing each line separately
388			// to preserve the transform while maintaining line breaks
389			usage := f.Usage
390			noTransform := styles.FlagDescription.UnsetTransform()
391			var helpLines []string
392			for i, line := range strings.Split(usage, "\n") {
393				if line == "" {
394					helpLines = append(helpLines, "")
395					continue
396				}
397				if i > 0 {
398					helpLines = append(helpLines, noTransform.Render(line))
399					continue
400				}
401				helpLines = append(helpLines, styles.FlagDescription.Render(line))
402			}
403			help := strings.Join(helpLines, "\n")
404	
405			if f.DefValue != "" && f.DefValue != "false" && f.DefValue != "0" && f.DefValue != "[]" {
406				help += styles.FlagDefault.Render(" (" + f.DefValue + ")")
407			}
408			flags[key] = help
409			keys = append(keys, key)
410		})
411		return flags, keys
412	}
413	
414	// result is map[groupID]map[styled cmd name]styled cmd help, and the keys in
415	// the order they are defined.
416	func evalCmds(c *cobra.Command, styles Styles) (map[string](map[string]string), []string) {
417		padStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().PaddingLeft(0) //nolint:mnd
418		keys := []string{}
419		cmds := map[string]map[string]string{}
420		for _, sc := range c.Commands() {
421			if sc.Hidden {
422				continue
423			}
424			if _, ok := cmds[sc.GroupID]; !ok {
425				cmds[sc.GroupID] = map[string]string{}
426			}
427			key := padStyle.Render(styleUsage(sc, styles.Program, false))
428			help := styles.FlagDescription.Render(sc.Short)
429			cmds[sc.GroupID][key] = help
430			keys = append(keys, key)
431		}
432		return cmds, keys
433	}
434	
435	func evalGroups(c *cobra.Command) (map[string]string, []string) {
436		// make sure the default group is the first
437		ids := []string{""}
438		groups := map[string]string{"": "commands"}
439		for _, g := range c.Groups() {
440			groups[g.ID] = g.Title
441			ids = append(ids, g.ID)
442		}
443		return groups, ids
444	}

446	func renderGroup(w io.Writer, styles Styles, space int, name string, items iter.Seq2[string, string]) {
447		_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w, styles.Title.Render(name))
448		for key, help := range items {
449			_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w, lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(
450				lipgloss.Left,
451				lipgloss.NewStyle().PaddingLeft(longPad).Render(key),
452				strings.Repeat(" ", space-lipgloss.Width(key)),
453				help,
454			))
455		}
456	}
457	
458	func calculateSpace(k1, k2 []string) int {
459		const spaceBetween = 2
460		space := minSpace
461		for _, k := range append(k1, k2...) {
462			space = max(space, lipgloss.Width(k)+spaceBetween)
463		}
464		return space
465	}
466	
467	func isSubCommand(c *cobra.Command, args []string, word string) bool {
468		cmd, _, _ := c.Root().Traverse(args)
469		return cmd != nil && cmd.Name() == word || slices.Contains(cmd.Aliases, word)
470	}

472	var redirectPrefixes = []string{">", "<", "&>", "2>", "1>", ">>", "2>>"}
473	
474	func isRedirect(s string) bool {
475		for _, p := range redirectPrefixes {
476			if strings.HasPrefix(s, p) {
477				return true
478			}
479		}
480		return false
481	}

53	    optionTerm: (option) => theme.option(option.flags),
54	    subcommandTerm: (cmd) => theme.command(cmd.name()),

56	
57	  program.configureOutput({
58	    writeOut: (str) => {
59	      const colored = str

62	        .replace(/^Commands:/gm, theme.heading("Commands:"));
63	      process.stdout.write(colored);
64	    },

68

70	    process.argv.includes("-V") ||
71	    process.argv.includes("--version") ||
72	    process.argv.includes("-v")
73	  ) {
74	    console.log(ctx.programVersion);
75	    process.exit(0);
76	  }

79	    if (hasEmittedCliBanner()) {
80	      return "";
81	    }
82	    const rich = isRich();
83	    const line = formatCliBannerLine(ctx.programVersion, { richTty: rich });
84	    return `\n${line}\n`;
85	  });

88	    ([cmd, desc]) => `  ${theme.command(replaceCliName(cmd, CLI_NAME))}\n    ${theme.muted(desc)}`,
89	  ).join("\n");
90

92	    if (command !== program) {
93	      return "";
94	    }

96	    return `\n${theme.heading("Examples:")}\n${fmtExamples}\n\n${theme.muted("Docs:")} ${docs}\n`;

1482	                .any(|result| result.must_pass && !result.passed);
1483	            if failed_required {

1485	            } else {

1487	            }

1489	        }
1490	        Err(err) => {

1492	                "{}",

1494	            );

107	  const values: string[] = [];

113	    }

2360	/// interactively when prompts are allowed (a TTY without --yes/--json/--plain/

2362	pub(crate) fn start_goal_plan(provided: Option<&str>, allows_prompts: bool) -> StartGoalPlan {
2363	    match provided.map(str::trim) {
2364	        Some(goal) if !goal.is_empty() => StartGoalPlan::Provided(goal.to_string()),
2365	        _ if allows_prompts => StartGoalPlan::Prompt,
2366	        _ => StartGoalPlan::Notice(
2367	            "no goal given and prompts are off; pass a goal: deadreckon start \"<goal>\""
2368	                .to_string(),
2369	        ),
2370	    }
2371	}

2373	/// Resolve the start goal, prompting interactively for it when none was given and
2374	/// prompts are allowed. Returns a friendly error (after a one-line notice) when
2375	/// no goal is available and prompts are suppressed.
2376	pub(crate) fn resolve_start_goal(provided: Option<String>, allows_prompts: bool) -> Result<String> {
2377	    match start_goal_plan(provided.as_deref(), allows_prompts) {
2378	        StartGoalPlan::Provided(goal) => Ok(goal),
2379	        StartGoalPlan::Prompt => {
2380	            let entered = crate::prompt::open("goal: ", None)?;
2381	            let goal = entered.trim().to_string();
2382	            if goal.is_empty() {
2383	                return Err(start_goal_required_error());
2384	            }
2385	            Ok(goal)
2386	        }
2387	        StartGoalPlan::Notice(message) => {
2388	            let _ = ui::writeln(ui::Stream::Stderr, ui::Tone::Note, &message);
2389	            Err(start_goal_required_error())
2390	        }
2391	    }
2392	}

118	export function getCoreCliCommandNames(): string[] {
119	  const seen = new Set<string>();
120	  const names: string[] = [];
121	  for (const entry of coreEntries) {
122	    for (const cmd of entry.commands) {
123	      if (seen.has(cmd.name)) {
124	        continue;
125	      }
126	      seen.add(cmd.name);
127	      names.push(cmd.name);
128	    }
129	  }
130	  return names;
131	}
132	
133	function removeCommand(program: Command, command: Command) {
134	  const commands = program.commands as Command[];
135	  const index = commands.indexOf(command);
136	  if (index >= 0) {
137	    commands.splice(index, 1);
138	  }
139	}
140	
141	function registerLazyCoreCommand(
142	  program: Command,
143	  ctx: ProgramContext,
144	  entry: CoreCliEntry,
145	  command: { name: string; description: string },
146	) {
147	  const placeholder = program.command(command.name).description(command.description);
148	  placeholder.allowUnknownOption(true);
149	  placeholder.allowExcessArguments(true);
150	  placeholder.action(async (...actionArgs) => {
151	    // Some registrars install multiple top-level commands (e.g. status/health/sessions).
152	    // Remove placeholders/old registrations for all names in the entry before re-registering.
153	    for (const cmd of entry.commands) {
154	      const existing = program.commands.find((c) => c.name() === cmd.name);
155	      if (existing) {
156	        removeCommand(program, existing);
157	      }
158	    }
159	    await entry.register({ program, ctx, argv: process.argv });
160	    await reparseProgramFromActionArgs(program, actionArgs);
161	  });
162	}
163	
164	export async function registerCoreCliByName(
165	  program: Command,
166	  ctx: ProgramContext,
167	  name: string,
168	  argv: string[] = process.argv,
169	): Promise<boolean> {
170	  const entry = coreEntries.find((candidate) =>
171	    candidate.commands.some((cmd) => cmd.name === name),
172	  );
173	  if (!entry) {
174	    return false;
175	  }
176	
177	  // Some registrars install multiple top-level commands (e.g. status/health/sessions).
178	  // Remove placeholders/old registrations for all names in the entry before re-registering.
179	  for (const cmd of entry.commands) {
180	    const existing = program.commands.find((c) => c.name() === cmd.name);
181	    if (existing) {
182	      removeCommand(program, existing);
183	    }
184	  }
185	  await entry.register({ program, ctx, argv });
186	  return true;
187	}
188	
189	export function registerCoreCliCommands(program: Command, ctx: ProgramContext, argv: string[]) {
190	  const primary = getPrimaryCommand(argv);
191	  if (primary && shouldRegisterCorePrimaryOnly(argv)) {
192	    const entry = coreEntries.find((candidate) =>
193	      candidate.commands.some((cmd) => cmd.name === primary),
194	    );
195	    if (entry) {
196	      const cmd = entry.commands.find((c) => c.name === primary);
197	      if (cmd) {
198	        registerLazyCoreCommand(program, ctx, entry, cmd);
199	      }
200	      return;
201	    }
202	  }
203	
204	  for (const entry of coreEntries) {
205	    for (const cmd of entry.commands) {
206	      registerLazyCoreCommand(program, ctx, entry, cmd);
207	    }
208	  }
209	}
210	
211	export function registerProgramCommands(
212	  program: Command,
213	  ctx: ProgramContext,
214	  argv: string[] = process.argv,
215	) {
216	  registerCoreCliCommands(program, ctx, argv);
217	  registerSubCliCommands(program, argv);
218	}

103	func WithNotifySignal(signals ...os.Signal) Option {

109	// Execute applies fang to the command and executes it.
110	func Execute(ctx context.Context, root *cobra.Command, options ...Option) error {
111		opts := settings{
112			manpages:    true,
113			completions: true,
114			colorscheme: DefaultColorScheme,
115			errHandler:  DefaultErrorHandler,
116		}
117	
118		for _, option := range options {
119			option(&opts)
120		}
121	
122		// Enable VT processing on Windows, otherwise, ANSI escape sequences might not work on older
123		// Windows versions. This is a no-op on other platforms.
124		for _, w := range []io.Writer{root.OutOrStdout(), root.ErrOrStderr()} {
125			// if we can't enable VT processing, just ignore it and continue
126			// without it.
127			_ = enableVirtualTerminalProcessing(w)
128		}
129	
130		helpFunc := func(c *cobra.Command, _ []string) {
131			w := colorprofile.NewWriter(c.OutOrStdout(), os.Environ())
132			helpFn(c, w, makeStyles(mustColorscheme(opts.colorscheme)))
133		}
134	
135		root.SilenceUsage = true
136		root.SilenceErrors = true
137		if !opts.skipVersion {
138			root.Version = buildVersion(opts)
139		}
140		root.SetHelpFunc(helpFunc)
141	
142		if opts.manpages {
143			root.AddCommand(&cobra.Command{
144				Use:                   "man",
145				Short:                 "Generates manpages",
146				SilenceUsage:          true,
147				DisableFlagsInUseLine: true,
148				Hidden:                true,
149				Args:                  cobra.NoArgs,
150				RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
151					page, err := mango.NewManPage(1, cmd.Root())
152					if err != nil {
153						//nolint:wrapcheck
154						return err
155					}
156					_, err = fmt.Fprint(os.Stdout, page.Build(roff.NewDocument()))
157					//nolint:wrapcheck
158					return err
159				},
160			})
161		}
162	
163		if !opts.completions {
164			root.CompletionOptions.DisableDefaultCmd = true
165		}
166	
167		if len(opts.signals) > 0 {
168			var cancel context.CancelFunc
169			ctx, cancel = signal.NotifyContext(ctx, opts.signals...)
170			defer cancel()
171		}
172	
173		if err := root.ExecuteContext(ctx); err != nil {
174			w := colorprofile.NewWriter(root.ErrOrStderr(), os.Environ())
175			opts.errHandler(w, makeStyles(mustColorscheme(opts.colorscheme)), err)
176			return err //nolint:wrapcheck
177		}
178		return nil
179	}

130	type BrowserOpenSupport = {
131	  ok: boolean;
132	  reason?: string;
133	  command?: string;
134	};
135	
136	type BrowserOpenCommand = {
137	  argv: string[] | null;
138	  reason?: string;
139	  command?: string;
140	  /**
141	   * Whether the URL must be wrapped in quotes when appended to argv.
142	   * Needed for Windows `cmd /c start` where `&` splits commands.
143	   */
144	  quoteUrl?: boolean;
145	};
146	
147	export async function resolveBrowserOpenCommand(): Promise<BrowserOpenCommand> {
148	  const platform = process.platform;
149	  const hasDisplay = Boolean(process.env.DISPLAY || process.env.WAYLAND_DISPLAY);
150	  const isSsh =
151	    Boolean(process.env.SSH_CLIENT) ||
152	    Boolean(process.env.SSH_TTY) ||
153	    Boolean(process.env.SSH_CONNECTION);
154	
155	  if (isSsh && !hasDisplay && platform !== "win32") {
156	    return { argv: null, reason: "ssh-no-display" };
157	  }
158	
159	  if (platform === "win32") {
160	    return {
161	      argv: ["cmd", "/c", "start", ""],
162	      command: "cmd",
163	      quoteUrl: true,
164	    };
165	  }
166	
167	  if (platform === "darwin") {
168	    const hasOpen = await detectBinary("open");
169	    return hasOpen ? { argv: ["open"], command: "open" } : { argv: null, reason: "missing-open" };
170	  }
171	
172	  if (platform === "linux") {
173	    const wsl = await isWSL();
174	    if (!hasDisplay && !wsl) {
175	      return { argv: null, reason: "no-display" };
176	    }
177	    if (wsl) {
178	      const hasWslview = await detectBinary("wslview");
179	      if (hasWslview) {
180	        return { argv: ["wslview"], command: "wslview" };
181	      }
182	      if (!hasDisplay) {
183	        return { argv: null, reason: "wsl-no-wslview" };
184	      }
185	    }
186	    const hasXdgOpen = await detectBinary("xdg-open");
187	    return hasXdgOpen
188	      ? { argv: ["xdg-open"], command: "xdg-open" }
189	      : { argv: null, reason: "missing-xdg-open" };
190	  }
191	
192	  return { argv: null, reason: "unsupported-platform" };
193	}
194	
195	export async function detectBrowserOpenSupport(): Promise<BrowserOpenSupport> {
196	  const resolved = await resolveBrowserOpenCommand();
197	  if (!resolved.argv) {
198	    return { ok: false, reason: resolved.reason };
199	  }
200	  return { ok: true, command: resolved.command };
201	}

236	export async function openUrl(url: string): Promise<boolean> {
237	  if (shouldSkipBrowserOpenInTests()) {
238	    return false;
239	  }
240	  const resolved = await resolveBrowserOpenCommand();
241	  if (!resolved.argv) {
242	    return false;
243	  }
244	  const quoteUrl = resolved.quoteUrl === true;
245	  const command = [...resolved.argv];
246	  if (quoteUrl) {
247	    if (command.at(-1) === "") {
248	      // Preserve the empty title token for `start` when using verbatim args.
249	      command[command.length - 1] = '""';
250	    }
251	    command.push(`"${url}"`);
252	  } else {
253	    command.push(url);
254	  }
255	  try {
256	    await runCommandWithTimeout(command, {
257	      timeoutMs: 5_000,
258	      windowsVerbatimArguments: quoteUrl,
259	    });
260	    return true;
261	  } catch {
262	    // ignore; we still print the URL for manual open
263	    return false;
264	  }
265	}

342	export async function detectBinary(name: string): Promise<boolean> {
343	  if (!name?.trim()) {
344	    return false;
345	  }
346	  if (!isSafeExecutableValue(name)) {
347	    return false;
348	  }
349	  const resolved = name.startsWith("~") ? resolveUserPath(name) : name;
350	  if (
351	    path.isAbsolute(resolved) ||
352	    resolved.startsWith(".") ||
353	    resolved.includes("/") ||
354	    resolved.includes("\\")
355	  ) {
356	    try {
357	      await fs.access(resolved);
358	      return true;
359	    } catch {
360	      return false;
361	    }
362	  }
363	
364	  const command = process.platform === "win32" ? ["where", name] : ["/usr/bin/env", "which", name];
365	  try {
366	    const result = await runCommandWithTimeout(command, { timeoutMs: 2000 });
367	    return result.code === 0 && result.stdout.trim().length > 0;
368	  } catch {
369	    return false;
370	  }
371	}

404	export async function waitForGatewayReachable(params: {
405	  url: string;
406	  token?: string;
407	  password?: string;
408	  /** Total time to wait before giving up. */
409	  deadlineMs?: number;
410	  /** Per-probe timeout (each probe makes a full gateway health request). */
411	  probeTimeoutMs?: number;
412	  /** Delay between probes. */
413	  pollMs?: number;
414	}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; detail?: string }> {
415	  const deadlineMs = params.deadlineMs ?? 15_000;
416	  const pollMs = params.pollMs ?? 400;
417	  const probeTimeoutMs = params.probeTimeoutMs ?? 1500;
418	  const startedAt = Date.now();
419	  let lastDetail: string | undefined;
420	
421	  while (Date.now() - startedAt < deadlineMs) {
422	    const probe = await probeGatewayReachable({
423	      url: params.url,
424	      token: params.token,
425	      password: params.password,
426	      timeoutMs: probeTimeoutMs,
427	    });
428	    if (probe.ok) {
429	      return probe;
430	    }
431	    lastDetail = probe.detail;
432	    await sleep(pollMs);
433	  }
434	
435	  return { ok: false, detail: lastDetail };
436	}
437	
438	function summarizeError(err: unknown): string {
439	  let raw = "unknown error";
440	  if (err instanceof Error) {
441	    raw = err.message || raw;
442	  } else if (typeof err === "string") {
443	    raw = err || raw;
444	  } else if (err !== undefined) {
445	    raw = inspect(err, { depth: 2 });
446	  }
447	  const line =
448	    raw
449	      .split("\n")
450	      .map((s) => s.trim())
451	      .find(Boolean) ?? raw;
452	  return line.length > 120 ? `${line.slice(0, 119)}…` : line;
453	}

302	export function formatAuthChoiceChoicesForCli(params?: {
303	  includeSkip?: boolean;
304	  includeLegacyAliases?: boolean;
305	}): string {
306	  const includeSkip = params?.includeSkip ?? true;
307	  const includeLegacyAliases = params?.includeLegacyAliases ?? false;
308	  const values = BASE_AUTH_CHOICE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => opt.value);
309	
310	  if (includeSkip) {
311	    values.push("skip");
312	  }
313	  if (includeLegacyAliases) {
314	    values.push(...AUTH_CHOICE_LEGACY_ALIASES_FOR_CLI);
315	  }
316	
317	  return values.join("|");
318	}
319	
320	export function buildAuthChoiceOptions(params: {
321	  store: AuthProfileStore;
322	  includeSkip: boolean;
323	}): AuthChoiceOption[] {
324	  void params.store;
325	  const options: AuthChoiceOption[] = [...BASE_AUTH_CHOICE_OPTIONS];
326	
327	  if (params.includeSkip) {
328	    options.push({ value: "skip", label: "Skip for now" });
329	  }
330	
331	  return options;
332	}
333	
334	export function buildAuthChoiceGroups(params: { store: AuthProfileStore; includeSkip: boolean }): {
335	  groups: AuthChoiceGroup[];
336	  skipOption?: AuthChoiceOption;
337	} {
338	  const options = buildAuthChoiceOptions({
339	    ...params,
340	    includeSkip: false,
341	  });
342	  const optionByValue = new Map<AuthChoice, AuthChoiceOption>(
343	    options.map((opt) => [opt.value, opt]),
344	  );
345	
346	  const groups = AUTH_CHOICE_GROUP_DEFS.map((group) => ({
347	    ...group,
348	    options: group.choices
349	      .map((choice) => optionByValue.get(choice))
350	      .filter((opt): opt is AuthChoiceOption => Boolean(opt)),
351	  }));
352	
353	  const skipOption = params.includeSkip
354	    ? ({ value: "skip", label: "Skip for now" } satisfies AuthChoiceOption)
355	    : undefined;
356	
357	  return { groups, skipOption };
358	}
359

1	import type { Command } from "commander";
2	import { setVerbose } from "../../globals.js";
3	import { isTruthyEnvValue } from "../../infra/env.js";
4	import { defaultRuntime } from "../../runtime.js";
5	import { getCommandPath, getVerboseFlag, hasHelpOrVersion } from "../argv.js";
6	import { emitCliBanner } from "../banner.js";
7	import { resolveCliName } from "../cli-name.js";
8	
9	function setProcessTitleForCommand(actionCommand: Command) {
10	  let current: Command = actionCommand;
11	  while (current.parent && current.parent.parent) {
12	    current = current.parent;
13	  }
14	  const name = current.name();
15	  const cliName = resolveCliName();
16	  if (!name || name === cliName) {
17	    return;
18	  }
19	  process.title = `${cliName}-${name}`;
20	}
21	
22	// Commands that need channel plugins loaded
23	const PLUGIN_REQUIRED_COMMANDS = new Set(["message", "channels", "directory"]);
24	
25	export function registerPreActionHooks(program: Command, programVersion: string) {
26	  program.hook("preAction", async (_thisCommand, actionCommand) => {
27	    setProcessTitleForCommand(actionCommand);
28	    const argv = process.argv;
29	    if (hasHelpOrVersion(argv)) {
30	      return;
31	    }
32	    const commandPath = getCommandPath(argv, 2);
33	    const hideBanner =
34	      isTruthyEnvValue(process.env.OPENCLAW_HIDE_BANNER) ||
35	      commandPath[0] === "update" ||
36	      commandPath[0] === "completion" ||
37	      (commandPath[0] === "plugins" && commandPath[1] === "update");
38	    if (!hideBanner) {
39	      emitCliBanner(programVersion);
40	    }
41	    const verbose = getVerboseFlag(argv, { includeDebug: true });
42	    setVerbose(verbose);
43	    if (!verbose) {
44	      process.env.NODE_NO_WARNINGS ??= "1";
45	    }
46	    if (commandPath[0] === "doctor" || commandPath[0] === "completion") {
47	      return;
48	    }
49	    const { ensureConfigReady } = await import("./config-guard.js");
50	    await ensureConfigReady({ runtime: defaultRuntime, commandPath });
51	    // Load plugins for commands that need channel access
52	    if (PLUGIN_REQUIRED_COMMANDS.has(commandPath[0])) {
53	      const { ensurePluginRegistryLoaded } = await import("../plugin-registry.js");
54	      ensurePluginRegistryLoaded();
55	    }
56	  });
57	}
58

69	    };

export async function noteChannelStatus(params: {
  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
  prompter: WizardPrompter;
  options?: SetupChannelsOptions;
  accountOverrides?: Partial<Record<ChannelChoice, string>>;
}): Promise<void> {
  const { statusLines } = await collectChannelStatus({
    cfg: params.cfg,
    options: params.options,
    accountOverrides: params.accountOverrides ?? {},
  });
  if (statusLines.length > 0) {
    await params.prompter.note(statusLines.join("\n"), "Channel status");
  }
}

async function noteChannelPrimer(
  prompter: WizardPrompter,
  channels: Array<{ id: ChannelChoice; blurb: string; label: string }>,
): Promise<void> {
  const channelLines = channels.map((channel) =>
    formatChannelPrimerLine({
      id: channel.id,
      label: channel.label,
      selectionLabel: channel.label,
      docsPath: "/",
      blurb: channel.blurb,
    }),
  );
  await prompter.note(
    [
      "DM security: default is pairing; unknown DMs get a pairing code.",
      `Approve with: ${formatCliCommand("openclaw pairing approve <channel> <code>")}`,
      'Public DMs require dmPolicy="open" + allowFrom=["*"].',
      "Multi-user DMs: run: " +
        formatCliCommand('openclaw config set session.dmScope "per-channel-peer"') +
        ' (or "per-account-channel-peer" for multi-account channels) to isolate sessions.',
      `Docs: ${formatDocsLink("/start/pairing", "start/pairing")}`,
      "",
      ...channelLines,
    ].join("\n"),
    "How channels work",
  );
}

function resolveQuickstartDefault(
  statusByChannel: Map<ChannelChoice, { quickstartScore?: number }>,
): ChannelChoice | undefined {
  let best: { channel: ChannelChoice; score: number } | null = null;
  for (const [channel, status] of statusByChannel) {
    if (status.quickstartScore == null) {
      continue;
    }
    if (!best || status.quickstartScore > best.score) {
      best = { channel, score: status.quickstartScore };
    }
  }
  return best?.channel;
}

async function maybeConfigureDmPolicies(params: {
  cfg: OpenClawConfig;
  selection: ChannelChoice[];
  prompter: WizardPrompter;
  accountIdsByChannel?: Map<ChannelChoice, string>;
}): Promise<OpenClawConfig> {
  const { selection, prompter, accountIdsByChannel } = params;
  const dmPolicies = selection
    .map((channel) => getChannelOnboardingAdapter(channel)?.dmPolicy)
    .filter(Boolean) as ChannelOnboardingDmPolicy[];
  if (dmPolicies.length === 0) {
    return params.cfg;
  }

  const wants = await prompter.confirm({
    message: "Configure DM access policies now? (default: pairing)",
    initialValue: false,
  });
  if (!wants) {
    return params.cfg;
  }

  let cfg = params.cfg;
  const selectPolicy = async (policy: ChannelOnboardingDmPolicy) => {
    await prompter.note(
      [
        "Default: pairing (unknown DMs get a pairing code).",
        `Approve: ${formatCliCommand(`openclaw pairing approve ${policy.channel} <code>`)}`,
        `Allowlist DMs: ${policy.policyKey}="allowlist" + ${policy.allowFromKey} entries.`,
        `Public DMs: ${policy.policyKey}="open" + ${policy.allowFromKey} includes "*".`,
        "Multi-user DMs: run: " +
          formatCliCommand('openclaw config set session.dmScope "per-channel-peer"') +
          ' (or "per-account-channel-peer" for multi-account channels) to isolate sessions.',
        `Docs: ${formatDocsLink("/start/pairing", "start/pairing")}`,
      ].join("\n"),
      `${policy.label} DM access`,
    );
    return (await prompter.select({
      message: `${policy.label} DM policy`,
      options: [
        { value: "pairing", label: "Pairing (recommended)" },
        { value: "allowlist", label: "Allowlist (specific users only)" },
        { value: "open", label: "Open (public inbound DMs)" },
        { value: "disabled", label: "Disabled (ignore DMs)" },
      ],
    })) as DmPolicy;
  };

  for (const policy of dmPolicies) {
    const current = policy.getCurrent(cfg);
    const nextPolicy = await selectPolicy(policy);
    if (nextPolicy !== current) {
      cfg = policy.setPolicy(cfg, nextPolicy);
    }
    if (nextPolicy === "allowlist" && policy.promptAllowFrom) {
      cfg = await policy.promptAllowFrom({
        cfg,
        prompter,
        accountId: accountIdsByChannel?.get(policy.channel),
      });
    }
  }

  return cfg;
}

9	
10	# Onboarding Wizard (CLI)
11	
12	The onboarding wizard is the **recommended** way to set up OpenClaw on macOS,
13	Linux, or Windows (via WSL2; strongly recommended).
14	It configures a local Gateway or a remote Gateway connection, plus channels, skills,
15	and workspace defaults in one guided flow.
16	
17	```bash
18	openclaw onboard
19	```
20	
21	<Info>
22	Fastest first chat: open the Control UI (no channel setup needed). Run
23	`openclaw dashboard` and chat in the browser. Docs: [Dashboard](/web/dashboard).
24	</Info>
25	
26	To reconfigure later:
27	
28	```bash
29	openclaw configure
30	openclaw agents add <name>
31	```
32	
33	<Note>
34	`--json` does not imply non-interactive mode. For scripts, use `--non-interactive`.
35	</Note>
36	
37	<Tip>
38	Recommended: set up a Brave Search API key so the agent can use `web_search`
39	(`web_fetch` works without a key). Easiest path: `openclaw configure --section web`
40	which stores `tools.web.search.apiKey`. Docs: [Web tools](/tools/web).
41	</Tip>
42	
43	## QuickStart vs Advanced
44	
45	The wizard starts with **QuickStart** (defaults) vs **Advanced** (full control).
46	
47	<Tabs>
48	  <Tab title="QuickStart (defaults)">
49	    - Local gateway (loopback)
50	    - Workspace default (or existing workspace)
51	    - Gateway port **18789**
52	    - Gateway auth **Token** (auto‑generated, even on loopback)
53	    - Tailscale exposure **Off**
54	    - Telegram + WhatsApp DMs default to **allowlist** (you'll be prompted for your phone number)
55	  </Tab>
56	  <Tab title="Advanced (full control)">
57	    - Exposes every step (mode, workspace, gateway, channels, daemon, skills).
58	  </Tab>
59	</Tabs>
60	
61	## What the wizard configures
62	
63	**Local mode (default)** walks you through these steps:
64	
65	1. **Model/Auth** — Anthropic API key (recommended), OpenAI, or Custom Provider
66	   (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, or Unknown auto-detect). Pick a default model.
67	2. **Workspace** — Location for agent files (default `~/.openclaw/workspace`). Seeds bootstrap files.
68	3. **Gateway** — Port, bind address, auth mode, Tailscale exposure.
69	4. **Channels** — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Mattermost, Signal, BlueBubbles, or iMessage.
70	5. **Daemon** — Installs a LaunchAgent (macOS) or systemd user unit (Linux/WSL2).
71	6. **Health check** — Starts the Gateway and verifies it's running.
72	7. **Skills** — Installs recommended skills and optional dependencies.
73	
74	<Note>
75	Re-running the wizard does **not** wipe anything unless you explicitly choose **Reset** (or pass `--reset`).
76	If the config is invalid or contains legacy keys, the wizard asks you to run `openclaw doctor` first.
77	</Note>
78	
79	**Remote mode** only configures the local client to connect to a Gateway elsewhere.
80	It does **not** install or change anything on the remote host.
81	
82	## Add another agent
83	
84	Use `openclaw agents add <name>` to create a separate agent with its own workspace,
85	sessions, and auth profiles. Running without `--workspace` launches the wizard.
86	
87	What it sets:
88	
89	- `agents.list[].name`
90	- `agents.list[].workspace`
91	- `agents.list[].agentDir`
92	
93	Notes:
94	
95	- Default workspaces follow `~/.openclaw/workspace-<agentId>`.
96	- Add `bindings` to route inbound messages (the wizard can do this).
97	- Non-interactive flags: `--model`, `--agent-dir`, `--bind`, `--non-interactive`.
98	
99	## Full reference
100	
101	For detailed step-by-step breakdowns, non-interactive scripting, Signal setup,
102	RPC API, and a full list of config fields the wizard writes, see the
103	[Wizard Reference](/reference/wizard).
104

106

108	- Onboarding overview: [Onboarding Overview](/start/onboarding-overview)
109	- macOS app onboarding: [Onboarding](/start/onboarding)
110	- Agent first-run ritual: [Agent Bootstrapping](/start/bootstrapping)

389	async fn collect_doctor_provider_findings(
390	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
391	    root: &toml::Value,
392	) -> Result<Vec<DoctorFinding>> {
393	    let Some(providers) = root.get("providers").and_then(toml::Value::as_table) else {
394	        return Ok(vec![DoctorFinding::failed(
395	            "providers",
396	            "providers table missing",
397	            Some("deadreckon init".to_string()),
398	        )]);
399	    };
400	    let registry = ProviderRegistry::with_overrides(paths.home())?;
401	    let mut findings = Vec::new();
402	    for (name, entry) in providers {
403	        let kind = entry
404	            .get("kind")
405	            .and_then(toml::Value::as_str)
406	            .unwrap_or(name);
407	        let kind_label = registry
408	            .get(name)
409	            .map(|descriptor| descriptor_kind_label(&descriptor.kind).to_string())
410	            .unwrap_or_else(|| config_provider_kind_label(kind).to_string());
411	        let subject = format!("provider {name} kind={kind_label}");
412	        if kind.contains("cli") || name.starts_with("cli:") {
413	            let binary = entry
414	                .get("binary")
415	                .and_then(toml::Value::as_str)
416	                .unwrap_or_else(|| {
417	                    if name.contains("claude") {
418	                        "claude"
419	                    } else {
420	                        "codex"
421	                    }
422	                });
423	            if command_exists(binary) || PathBuf::from(binary).exists() {
424	                // Presence says "installed", the auth probe says "usable":
425	                // surface installed-but-logged-out here instead of mid-run.
426	                let probe_status = registry
427	                    .get(name)
428	                    .and_then(|descriptor| descriptor.auth_probe.as_ref())
429	                    .map(|probe| (probe, probe_cli_auth(binary, probe)));
430	                match probe_status {
431	                    Some((_, CliAuthStatus::LoggedIn)) => {
432	                        findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
433	                            subject,
434	                            format!("CLI binary {binary} found; logged in"),
435	                            Some(format!(
436	                                "deadreckon run \"goal\" --provider {name} --preview"
437	                            )),
438	                        ));
439	                    }
440	                    Some((probe, CliAuthStatus::NotLoggedIn { detail })) => {
441	                        findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
442	                            subject,
443	                            format!("CLI binary {binary} installed but not logged in ({detail})"),
444	                            probe
445	                                .login_try_lines
446	                                .first()
447	                                .cloned()
448	                                .or_else(|| Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string())),
449	                        ));
450	                    }
451	                    _ => {
452	                        findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
453	                            subject,
454	                            format!("CLI binary {binary} found"),
455	                            Some(format!(
456	                                "deadreckon run \"goal\" --provider {name} --preview"
457	                            )),
458	                        ));
459	                    }
460	                }
461	            } else {
462	                findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
463	                    subject,
464	                    format!("CLI binary {binary} missing"),
465	                    Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
466	                ));
467	            }
468	        } else if provider_has_key(entry) {
469	            if std::env::var_os("DEADRECKON_DOCTOR_PING").is_some() {
470	                findings.push(collect_doctor_provider_ping(paths, name, &kind_label).await?);
471	            } else {
472	                findings.push(DoctorFinding::passed(
473	                    subject,
474	                    "credential present; ping skipped",
475	                    Some("DEADRECKON_DOCTOR_PING=1 deadreckon doctor".to_string()),
476	                ));
477	            }
478	        } else {
479	            findings.push(DoctorFinding::failed(
480	                subject,
481	                "credential missing",
482	                Some(format!(
483	                    "deadreckon config set providers.{name}.api_key <KEY>"
484	                )),
485	            ));
486	        }
487	    }
488	    Ok(findings)
489	}

491	async fn collect_doctor_provider_ping(
492	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
493	    name: &str,
494	    kind_label: &str,
495	) -> Result<DoctorFinding> {
496	    let router = ProviderRouter::from_config_path(&paths.config_path(), Some(name))?;
497	    let request = ProviderRequest {
498	        prompt: "Reply with OK only.".to_string(),
499	        max_output_tokens: 8,
500	        cwd: None,
501	        output_path: None,
502	        sandbox_backend: None,
503	        pid_file: None,
504	        cancellation_token: None,
505	    };
506	    let subject = format!("provider {name} kind={kind_label}");
507	    match tokio::time::timeout(
508	        std::time::Duration::from_secs(20),
509	        router.complete(&request),
510	    )
511	    .await
512	    {
513	        Ok(Ok(response)) => Ok(DoctorFinding::passed(
514	            subject,
515	            format!("ping ok model {}", response.model),
516	            Some(format!(
517	                "deadreckon run \"goal\" --provider {name} --preview"
518	            )),
519	        )),
520	        Ok(Err(err)) => Ok(DoctorFinding::failed(
521	            subject,
522	            format!("ping failed: {err}"),
523	            Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
524	        )),
525	        Err(_) => Ok(DoctorFinding::failed(
526	            subject,
527	            "ping timed out",
528	            Some("deadreckon config provider".to_string()),
529	        )),
530	    }
531	}

115	    defaultProvider: DEFAULT_PROVIDER,
116	    defaultModel: DEFAULT_MODEL,
117	  });
118	  const configModel = resolved.model ?? DEFAULT_MODEL;
119	  const configContextTokens =
120	    cfg.agents?.defaults?.contextTokens ??
121	    lookupContextTokens(configModel) ??
122	    DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TOKENS;
123	
124	  const now = Date.now();
125	  const storeCache = new Map<string, Record<string, SessionEntry | undefined>>();
126	  const loadStore = (storePath: string) => {
127	    const cached = storeCache.get(storePath);
128	    if (cached) {
129	      return cached;
130	    }
131	    const store = loadSessionStore(storePath);
132	    storeCache.set(storePath, store);
133	    return store;
134	  };
135	  const buildSessionRows = (
136	    store: Record<string, SessionEntry | undefined>,
137	    opts: { agentIdOverride?: string } = {},
138	  ) =>
139	    Object.entries(store)
140	      .filter(([key]) => key !== "global" && key !== "unknown")
141	      .map(([key, entry]) => {
142	        const updatedAt = entry?.updatedAt ?? null;
143	        const age = updatedAt ? now - updatedAt : null;
144	        const model = entry?.model ?? configModel ?? null;
145	        const contextTokens =
146	          entry?.contextTokens ?? lookupContextTokens(model) ?? configContextTokens ?? null;
147	        const total = resolveFreshSessionTotalTokens(entry);
148	        const totalTokensFresh =
149	          typeof entry?.totalTokens === "number" ? entry?.totalTokensFresh !== false : false;
150	        const remaining =
151	          contextTokens != null && total !== undefined ? Math.max(0, contextTokens - total) : null;
152	        const pct =
153	          contextTokens && contextTokens > 0 && total !== undefined
154	            ? Math.min(999, Math.round((total / contextTokens) * 100))
155	            : null;
156	        const parsedAgentId = parseAgentSessionKey(key)?.agentId;
157	        const agentId = opts.agentIdOverride ?? parsedAgentId;

159	        return {

167	          verboseLevel: entry?.verboseLevel,
168	          reasoningLevel: entry?.reasoningLevel,
169	          elevatedLevel: entry?.elevatedLevel,
170	          systemSent: entry?.systemSent,
171	          abortedLastRun: entry?.abortedLastRun,
172	          inputTokens: entry?.inputTokens,
173	          outputTokens: entry?.outputTokens,
174	          totalTokens: total ?? null,
175	          totalTokensFresh,

1	import type { RuntimeEnv } from "../runtime.js";
2	import { readConfigFileSnapshot, resolveGatewayPort } from "../config/config.js";
3	import { copyToClipboard } from "../infra/clipboard.js";
4	import { defaultRuntime } from "../runtime.js";
5	import {
6	  detectBrowserOpenSupport,
7	  formatControlUiSshHint,
8	  openUrl,
9	  resolveControlUiLinks,
10	} from "./onboard-helpers.js";
11	
12	type DashboardOptions = {
13	  noOpen?: boolean;
14	};
15	
16	export async function dashboardCommand(
17	  runtime: RuntimeEnv = defaultRuntime,
18	  options: DashboardOptions = {},
19	) {
20	  const snapshot = await readConfigFileSnapshot();
21	  const cfg = snapshot.valid ? snapshot.config : {};
22	  const port = resolveGatewayPort(cfg);
23	  const bind = cfg.gateway?.bind ?? "loopback";
24	  const basePath = cfg.gateway?.controlUi?.basePath;
25	  const customBindHost = cfg.gateway?.customBindHost;
26	  const token = cfg.gateway?.auth?.token ?? process.env.OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN ?? "";
27	
28	  // LAN URLs fail secure-context checks in browsers.
29	  // Coerce only lan->loopback and preserve other bind modes.
30	  const links = resolveControlUiLinks({
31	    port,
32	    bind: bind === "lan" ? "loopback" : bind,
33	    customBindHost,
34	    basePath,
35	  });
36	  // Prefer URL fragment to avoid leaking auth tokens via query params.
37	  const dashboardUrl = token
38	    ? `${links.httpUrl}#token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`
39	    : links.httpUrl;
40	
41	  runtime.log(`Dashboard URL: ${dashboardUrl}`);
42	
43	  const copied = await copyToClipboard(dashboardUrl).catch(() => false);
44	  runtime.log(copied ? "Copied to clipboard." : "Copy to clipboard unavailable.");
45	
46	  let opened = false;
47	  let hint: string | undefined;
48	  if (!options.noOpen) {
49	    const browserSupport = await detectBrowserOpenSupport();
50	    if (browserSupport.ok) {
51	      opened = await openUrl(dashboardUrl);
52	    }
53	    if (!opened) {
54	      hint = formatControlUiSshHint({
55	        port,
56	        basePath,
57	        token: token || undefined,
58	      });
59	    }
60	  } else {
61	    hint = "Browser launch disabled (--no-open). Use the URL above.";
62	  }
63	
64	  if (opened) {
65	    runtime.log("Opened in your browser. Keep that tab to control OpenClaw.");
66	  } else if (hint) {
67	    runtime.log(hint);
68	  }
69	}

10	function summarizeInstallFailure(message: string): string | undefined {

12	  if (!cleaned) {
13	    return undefined;
14	  }
15	  const maxLen = 140;
16	  return cleaned.length > maxLen ? `${cleaned.slice(0, maxLen - 1)}…` : cleaned;
17	}

19	function formatSkillHint(skill: {

21	  install: Array<{ label: string }>;
22	}): string {
23	  const desc = skill.description?.trim();
24	  const installLabel = skill.install[0]?.label?.trim();
25	  const combined = desc && installLabel ? `${desc} — ${installLabel}` : desc || installLabel;
26	  if (!combined) {
27	    return "install";
28	  }
29	  const maxLen = 90;
30	  return combined.length > maxLen ? `${combined.slice(0, maxLen - 1)}…` : combined;

  const accountIdsByChannel = new Map<ChannelChoice, string>();

    options?.onAccountId?.(channel, accountId);

    adapter?.onAccountRecorded?.(accountId, options);

  const selection: ChannelChoice[] = [];
  const addSelection = (channel: ChannelChoice) => {

    }

  const resolveDisabledHint = (channel: ChannelChoice): string | undefined => {
    const plugin = getChannelPlugin(channel);
    if (!plugin) {
      if (next.plugins?.entries?.[channel]?.enabled === false) {
        return "plugin disabled";
      }
      if (next.plugins?.enabled === false) {
        return "plugins disabled";
      }
      return undefined;
    }
    const accountId = resolveChannelDefaultAccountId({ plugin, cfg: next });
    const account = plugin.config.resolveAccount(next, accountId);
    let enabled: boolean | undefined;
    if (plugin.config.isEnabled) {
      enabled = plugin.config.isEnabled(account, next);
    } else if (typeof (account as { enabled?: boolean })?.enabled === "boolean") {
      enabled = (account as { enabled?: boolean }).enabled;
    } else if (
      typeof (next.channels as Record<string, { enabled?: boolean }> | undefined)?.[channel]
        ?.enabled === "boolean"
    ) {
      enabled = (next.channels as Record<string, { enabled?: boolean }>)[channel]?.enabled;
    }
    return enabled === false ? "disabled" : undefined;

      const hint = [status?.selectionHint, disabledHint].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || undefined;

fn help<const N: usize>(args: [&str; N]) -> String {
    help_slice(&args)
}

fn help_slice(args: &[&str]) -> String {
    let output = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_deadreckon"))
        .args(args)
        .output()
        .expect("help");
    assert!(output.status.success(), "{}", stderr(&output));
    stdout(&output)
}

fn repo_file_text(relative: &str) -> String {
    let manifest = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
    let repo = manifest
        .parent()
        .and_then(|path| path.parent())
        .expect("repo");
    fs::read_to_string(repo.join(relative)).expect(relative)
}

fn section_between<'a>(text: &'a str, start: &str, end: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    let after_start = text.split_once(start)?.1;
    Some(
        after_start
            .split_once(end)
            .map_or(after_start, |(section, _)| section),
    )
}

# SpecStory CLI Help Experience — Full Anatomy

**Stack: Go + Cobra (`spf13/cobra v1.10.2`) + Charmbracelet Fang (`charmbracelet/fang v0.4.4`, which uses lipgloss v2 + colorprofile + charmtone) + pre-rendered ANSI logo files embedded via `go:embed`.**

---

## 1. The ASCII art banner

The banner is NOT generated at runtime. It is **12 pre-rendered ANSI text files** embedded into the binary, all containing the identical 6-line ASCII art (verified identical via checksum), differing only in 256-color escape codes. The plain art (ANSI stripped):

```
  ____                  ____  _                   
 / ___| _ __   ___  ___/ ___|| |_ ___  _ __ _   _ 
 \___ \| '_ \ / _ \/ __\___ \| __/ _ \| '__| | | |
  ___) | |_) |  __/ (__ ___) | || (_) | |  | |_| |
 |____/| .__/ \___|\___|____/ \__\___/|_|   \__, |
       |_|                                  |___/ 
```

(standard figlet "standard" font, "SpecStory"). Files live in `/Users/gdc/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/utils/logos/` (`logo_grad_blue.txt`, `logo_sunset.txt`, `logo_dawn.txt`, `logo_nebula.txt`, `logo_ocean.txt`, `logo_fire.txt`, `logo_forest.txt`, `logo_gold.txt`, `logo_purple.txt`, `logo_mint.txt`, `logo_coral.txt`, `logo_matrix.txt`).

**Encoding detail (critical for reproducing the feel):** every single character is individually wrapped in a 256-color foreground escape, e.g. `ESC[38;5;75m_ESC[39m` — deliberately **256-color (`38;5;N`), not 24-bit truecolor, for Terminal.app compatibility**. Per the comment in `/Users/gdc/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/utils/logos.go`:

```go
// Logo data embedded from files (256-color versions for Terminal.app compatibility)
// See .specstory/history/2025-08-06_18-51-59Z-bash-input-npx-oh.md ...
// for the history of how these logos were created and how to regenerate them, ensuring they are 256 color versions, not 24-bit color versions
```

The referenced history filename (`bash-input-npx-oh.md`) indicates they were generated with **`npx oh-my-logo`** (a figlet + gradient tool), then captured to files. (The history files themselves are no longer in the repo.)

**Random selection** — `/Users/gdc/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/utils/logos.go`:

```go
// GetRandomLogo returns a randomly selected colored logo
func GetRandomLogo() string {
	return ColoredLogos[rand.Intn(len(ColoredLogos))]
}
```

Every help invocation shows a **randomly chosen palette** — this is the core delight mechanic.

## 2. Help screen structure & rendering

### The hook — `/Users/gdc/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/cmd/help.go`

```go
func DisplayLogoAndHelp(cmd *cobra.Command) {
	fmt.Println() // Add visual separation before the logo
	fmt.Println(utils.GetRandomLogo())
	_ = cmd.Help()
}
```

A custom `help` command (`Use: "help [command]"`, alias `h`) calls this; unknown subcommands print `Unknown command: X` then logo + root help. The root command's bare `Run` also calls `cmdpkg.DisplayLogoAndHelp(c)` (main.go:245-253), so `specstory` with no args = banner + help.

### Execution wiring — `main.go:1628`

```go
if err := fang.Execute(context.Background(), rootCmd, fang.WithVersion(version)); err != nil {
```

`fang.Execute` calls `root.SetHelpFunc(helpFunc)` — so `cmd.Help()` above routes into **fang's styled help renderer** (`helpFn` in fang's `help.go`). Fang also sets `SilenceUsage/SilenceErrors`, adds a hidden `man` command, and shell completions.

### Layout produced by fang's `helpFn` (fang@v0.4.4/help.go), top to bottom:

1. **Description** — `cmp.Or(c.Long, c.Short)`, wrapped to terminal width (capped at 120 cols), 2-space left pad.
2. **`USAGE` title** — bold, uppercase-transformed, purple, `Padding(1,0)` + `Margin(0,2)`.
3. **Usage codeblock** — background-tinted block, `MarginLeft(2)`, `Padding(1,2)`; usage line is tokenized: program name, subcommand, and dimmed `[command] [args] [--flags]` placeholders each styled separately.
4. **`EXAMPLES` title + codeblock** — `cmd.Example` is parsed line by line; `# comment` lines styled as comments; shell lines get full **syntax highlighting** (program name, subcommands, `--flags`, `"quoted strings"`, arguments, pipes/redirects all distinct colors). Long lines truncated with `…`.
5. **`COMMANDS` section(s)** — two-column: styled command name (4-space left pad) + description, aligned via computed `space` shared with the flags column (min 10).
6. **`FLAGS` section** — `-s --session` style keys (flag color), descriptions with **first word auto-Title-cased** (`titleFirstWord` transform), and defaults appended dimmed as ` (value)` when non-empty/non-false/non-zero.
7. Trailing blank line.

Errors render a `ERROR` badge (bold, butter-on-cherry background, padded) + message, and for usage errors append: `Try` ` --help ` `for usage.` with the flag styled. If stderr is not a TTY, plain `err.Error()` only.

### SpecStory's actual help content (main.go `createRootCommand`)

```go
Use:   "specstory [command]",
Short: "SpecStory auto-saves terminal coding agent chat interactions",
Long:  `SpecStory is a wrapper for terminal coding agents that auto-saves markdown files of all your chat interactions.`
       // + "\n\nSupported agents: " + providerList + "."
```

Examples are **dynamically built from the provider registry**, with comment lines:

```
# Check terminal coding agents installation
specstory check

# Run the default agent with auto-saving
specstory run

# Run a specific agent with auto-saving
specstory run <each provider id>

# Run with custom command
specstory run claude -c "/custom/path/to/agent"

# Generate markdown files for all agent sessions associated with the current directory
specstory sync

# Generate markdown files for specific agent sessions
specstory sync -s <session-id>
...
# Watch for any agent activity in the current directory and generate markdown files
specstory watch
```

Subcommands: `run` (alias `r`), `watch`, `sync` (alias `s`), `list`, `version` (aliases `v`, `ver`), `check`, `login`, `logout`, custom `help` (alias `h`). Hidden flags (`--cloud-token`, `--cloud-url`, `--debug-raw`, `--provenance`) are filtered out of help by fang (`if f.Hidden { return }`).

## 4. Banner shown vs suppressed

- **Shown** (random palette each time): bare `specstory` (root Run), `specstory help`, `specstory help <cmd>`, `specstory help <unknown>` (after "Unknown command: X").
- **NOT shown**: `specstory --help` / `specstory <cmd> --help` (these go straight to fang's helpFunc — styled help, no logo); error-triggered usage (main.go:1659 calls `rootCmd.Usage()` only, and only for cobra command/flag errors detected by string-matching `"unknown command"`, `"unknown flag"`, etc.); `--silent` is not checked for the banner, but the banner paths only run in interactive-help situations.
- **TTY detection**: the logo itself is printed raw with `fmt.Println` — **no TTY/NO_COLOR detection for the banner** (the embedded ANSI always goes out). The fang help text, however, goes through `colorprofile.NewWriter(c.OutOrStdout(), os.Environ())`, which downgrades/strips colors based on TTY, `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR_FORCE`, and `TERM`. Fang also drops the codeblock's vertical padding when the profile is ASCII/no-TTY or there's no background color (`help.go:57-59`). Terminal width: `min(actual, 120)`, fallback 120.

**Personality copy** (`pkg/cmd/logout.go`, `login.go`): "🎉 Good news! You're not logged in! / ✨ Nothing to log out from - All is well in the universe! 💫"; declining logout → "🎊 Awesome! You're staying connected! / 🚀 Keep on building amazing things! 💪"; "💝 Thanks for using SpecStory! See you again soon! ✨"; login: "🌐 Opening your browser…", "🚀 Ready to sync with SpecStory Cloud! 💪".

**Helpful empty states**: no agent activity prints a numbered "To fix this:" list; invalid provider prints a bulleted registered-provider list with `• id - Name` plus an example invocation. Errors get visual-separation blank lines before/after.

### Reproducing in Rust — closest equivalents
- Banner: pre-render figlet "standard" font + per-character 256-color gradient (or use a small gradient function at runtime); store 10-12 palettes, pick randomly.
- Help framework: `clap` with a custom help template gets you partway, but fang's look (section titles in purple caps, background-tinted code blocks with syntax-highlighted examples, adaptive light/dark) is best rebuilt with `clap` + manual rendering using `owo-colors`/`anstyle` + `terminal_size` (cap 120), honoring `NO_COLOR`/TTY via `anstream`. Key signature elements: 2-space margins, 4-space command indent, shared column alignment between commands and flags, uppercase bold purple `#6B50FF` titles, dimmed `[command] [--flags]` placeholders, and `# comment` + highlighted shell-example codeblocks.
